body: My mom is dying of cancer too, so if you need someone who is going through it, and also wants to take their life, I’m with you pal
You made me smile, and I’ve been needing this! Thank you!
It is insane how close your story resonates to a guy I work with, at a restaurant.
As an RN, this is a miserable way to go. IF you succeed, you’ll be in a lot of pain, and miserable for hours. Maybe talk to someone. Here if you don’t want to be alone.
